title: Toward a World Model for Biomolecular Dynamics through Latent Ensemble Decomposition with OriDynamic

affiliations.2: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China

suggested_hero.en: Biomolecular ensembles, from states to fluctuations.
suggested_hero.zh: 从结构状态到原子涨落，探索生物分子构象系综。
suggested_hero.description_en: OriDynamic generates molecular-context-conditioned ensembles through latent ensemble decomposition: sampling representative states across conformational basins, then exploring all-atom variability within them.
suggested_hero.description_zh: OriDynamic 通过潜空间系综分解生成由分子环境条件化的构象系综：先跨构象盆地采样代表性状态，再探索各状态内的全原子构象变化。

homepage_abstract.en: Molecular recognition, catalysis and biological regulation are shaped by the coordinated conformational dynamics of interacting biomolecules. Learning the joint organization of alternative conformational states and their associated atomic fluctuations remains a central challenge. We present OriDynamic, a unified generative framework for all-atom conformational ensembles of protein monomers, protein–ligand complexes and protein–protein assemblies. OriDynamic introduces a latent ensemble decomposition that decouples global basin exploration and local exploitation in conformational landscapes, guided by ensemble-level statistical supervision. Across these systems, OriDynamic improves agreement with reference fluctuation statistics and conformational distributions, while recovering experimentally observed alternative states alongside partner-dependent structural responses, with an extension for sampling configurations associated with ligand dissociation. By enabling systematic exploration of conformational variability, OriDynamic provides a dynamical foundation for AI-driven drug discovery and marks a step toward biological intelligence grounded in the dynamic biomolecular world.

highlights.en: A single model generates conformational ensembles across protein monomers, protein–ligand complexes, and protein–protein assemblies.

highlights.en_title: From alternative states to local fluctuations
highlights.en: Combines latent-space exploration of alternative conformations with conditional all-atom sampling to capture local variability within each state.
Joint supervision of mean atomic positions, fluctuation amplitudes, and coordinate covariance captures how atoms fluctuate individually and together.
Achieves leading flexibility correlations across four benchmarks, alongside strong agreement with reference conformational distributions and interaction geometry.
Recovers experimentally observed alternative states and captures shifts in apo–holo conformational distributions in response to ligand or protein partners.
